endpoint: regional project IAM image endpoint root or /v2 suffix; compiled prefix de-dup preserves proxy and original exact saved endpoint

request.patch: add/replace/remove typed values at single decoded JSON pointer property; reject owner and readonly fields; property protection remains provider policy
request.scope: caller auth view, owner is metadata, never adopt owner scope
request.list: all pinned SDK filters plus source base comparisons, custom-property filters, created_at/updated_at and legacy sort_key/sort_dir; explicit empty tag remains tag= per pinned server (native helper omits it); forbid pagination/control override via custom property keys
request.create: all SDK fields; API confirmed explicit nullable name/container/disk formats and explicit zero/false/empty arrays; flatten protected string custom properties

response.mapping: complete pinned SDK image/member fields; exact optional Integer; timestamps preserve naive text and normalize legitimate instants UTC

errors.413: quota_exceeded by pinned Selectel images-go status rule (not provider-text inference)
errors.malformed_success: protocol_error with accepted mutation receipt/trustworthy IDs preserved

retry: safe reads bounded; mutations single transmission no replay
pagination: strict next marker links, bounded prefix/cursor for images; member response nonpaginated bounded local replay
wait: image.active/image.absent or member.accepted/member.absent exact-ref observation; unknown states never success
requested_id: Create optional caller UUID validated before I/O, endpoint-bound pure internal target builder retains exact requested address on error, never creation proof; no BindDocumented API exists in baseline; no source/auth/HTTP callbacks
recovery: known receipt conclusive including no-ID; unknown exact-ref GET indeterminate, no replay/name lookup/adoption
